top_signals.title: Bank of Canada Troubled by High Gas Prices, Warns of Hike Risk
top_signals.summary: The Bank of Canada’s governing council warned that it may need to hike interest rates, saying the longer gasoline prices remain elevated, the more likely that would pass through to other goods and services.

top_signals.title: US Export Prices Rise More than Expected
top_signals.summary: US export prices increased 0.6% month-over-month in August 2026, exceeding market expectations for a 0.5% rise and rebounding from a revised 1.4% decline in July. The increase was broad-based, with both agricultural and nonagricultural export prices advancing.
